non_nn_module.description: Guard-harvesting benchmarks (null-deref, div-by-zero, etc.) — structurally ineligible for CVC5 cross-validation.

unsafe_model_expected.description: Intentionally-buggy nn.Module models correctly identified as UNSAFE by TensorGuard. No safety certificate produced (by design). CVC5 cross-validation is inapplicable because there is no certificate to validate.

custom_propagator.description: Models using Z3 UserPropagator extensions not in SMT-LIB 2.6.

verification_error.description: Models where verify_model() raised an exception during AST extraction or constraint encoding.

timeout.description: Models where Z3 or CVC5 timed out (>30s).

validated_benchmarks.original_50_inline: All 50 inline models from run_cross_solver_validation.py were previously validated (50/50 Z3, 50/50 CVC5). See cross_solver_validation_results.json for details.
